data.professional_title: Business Analyst | Product Owner | Payments & Capital Markets Expert
data.summary: Dynamic and certified Business Analyst and Product Owner with over 18 years of experience in Core Banking, Investment Banking, and Global Payments. Proven track record of leading regulatory transformations, digital payment innovations, and delivering high-impact projects using Agile/SAFe frameworks. Specialized in SWIFT (MT/MX), ISO 20022, FIX protocols, SEPA, and capital markets, with expertise in stakeholder management, product lifecycle ownership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Certified International Payment Systems Professional (CIPSP™)
Equity Derivatives Certification – NISM (NSE India)
Fundamental Equity Analyst Certification – NISM (NSE India)
Chartered Wealth Manager (CWM) – Level 1
Key Skills & Expertise
End-to-End Business Analysis & Product Ownership
Agile, Scrum, SAFe Delivery Methodologies
Global Payments: SWIFT MT/MX, ISO 20022, SEPA, CHAPS, FPS
Capital Markets: Trade Lifecycle, T+2, IPOs, FIX, Margin Trading
Tools: JIRA, Confluence, Visio, SQL, Charles River
Process Modelling, Workflow Analysis, UAT & QA Oversight
Cross-Functional Team Leadership & Stakeholder Communication
Capital Markets Experience
Delivered T+2 settlement projects for Tadawul Stock Exchange.
Led Aramco IPO implementation for NCBC (KSA).
Managed lifecycle integration using Charles River with investment banks.
Delivered Margin Trading (Islamic and conventional) systems at NCBC.
Created and onboarded regulatory profiles on Tadawul stock exchange applications.
Supported FIX messaging protocol testing and implementation.
Used SQL to extract, sort, and analyze user and transaction data.
Payments Domain Experience
Managed SWIFT MT messages: MT103, MT101, MT202, MT200, MT199, MT190, MT192, MT196.
Executed ISO 20022/CBPR+ transitions using Pacs.008, Pacs.009, CAMT messages.
Built and validated MX message files for inbound and outbound transactions.
Worked on SEPA STEP2, CHAPS, FPS, BULK, SO, and DD transactions.
Familiar with payment formats and codes – IBAN, BBAN, BIC.
Executed domestic/international payments with compliance to FATCA.
Core Responsibilities
Gathered business requirements and authored detailed documentation.
Acted as liaison between technical and business teams for smooth delivery.
Analyzed and optimized payment and trading workflows; created gap analyses.
Led UAT cycles, authored test plans, coordinated QA activities.
Created reports and dashboards for project status, risks, and progress.
Supported sprint planning, retrospectives, and backlog prioritization.
Mentored teams on domain knowledge across payments and capital markets.
